name: Hamilcar of Kane
source:
Hamilcar of Kane is the leader of the Order of the Universal Panacea, and a descendant of its founder Ubar of Kane. As a child, he suffered an accident which led him to replace various body parts with artificed prosthetics. Relatedly, he is a renowned Golemancer, specializing in modular prosthetics.

Eshmun is his creation. 

[Edited from [url=https://everblossom.miraheze.org/wiki/Hamilcar_of_Kane]The Flower That Bloomed Nowhere Wiki[/url]]
